svg.title: Five layers on one GB10, and the ledger beside every one
svg.text: Five layers on one box, and the ledger beside every one.
Whatever a layer does is an event on the ledger first; the CBOM, the plan and the pages are rebuilt from it.
two GB10s, then GB300, XE, an AI
the kit on one Dell Pro Max GB10; the lab runs the same layers on an x86_64 server, its models behind one seam
